title: census.py summary prints the phase-2 reading queue's size and estimated tokens, and each census phase records an ops row with its wall time and counts
goal: census.py summary LOG adds a queue block computed with no network and no model: the rows phase 2 must read (bucket not OK, note not blocked, no outcome yet), the facts citing them (rag.py src --cited counts), the characters of their factdiff review passages and, for rows without review items, of the whole documents held in _cache/factdiff (a not-cached count when absent), and the tokens estimated at characters/4, split by provider host; census.py check, record and confirm and factdiff.py detect, apply and review each write one ops row census.phase (phase, date, ms, rows per bucket or outcome, exit) through ql_capture.record as tests.py writes test.run, and the digest's ops block counts them; the 2026-09-26 log's queue figure is recorded in kb/_self/reports/fact-diff.md as the census baseline.
notes: Premise run 2026-10-10: python3 _tools/census.py summary kb/public/_census/2026-09-26.csv printed bucket, outcome and needs-reading-by-note counts and the confirmed count, and nothing about the size of what phase 2 reads (no facts, characters or tokens); no census.phase ops row exists (git grep census.phase in _tools finds nothing). This story sets the baseline the epic's later stories are measured against, so it lands first. Its test selector collects no test until the work adds _tools/test_census.py. The tokens estimate follows kb/_self/usage.md's characters/4 convention.
